skill.summary: Akeneo PIM REST API skill. Use when working with Akeneo PIM REST for api. Covers 137 endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of lap-akeneo-pim-rest-api.

- Provides Akeneo PIM REST API access with 137 endpoints.
- Supports authentication via API key in headers.
- Enables operations for products, product models, families, attributes, categories, media files, and more.
- Includes setup instructions and example usage.
- Requires configuring AKENEO_PIM_REST_API_KEY environment variable.
